_form_note: Student_Scholarship (Zoho form 'Student – Scholarship'). Verified against Zoho_To_CHEDS_(25).ds field definitions + push workflow 'push_api_production14'. Raw columns = HEDB 202601 'Students - Scholarship' Database Field Names. Last_Updated is not imported. Reason_why_Emirates_ID_is_missing is on the form but not in the HEDB dataset, so it isn't imported (its validation is inactive).

fields._note: Text. Numeric IDs of 10+ digits are written as TEXT by the engine (no 2.6E+10 truncation).
Text field. Written as TEXT by the engine so all 15 digits survive (7.84E+14 / 1E+15 problem). 999999999999999 if not available. Form 'on user input' rejects anything under 15 digits.

value_map.U: Unreported due to privacy laws applicable (e.g. GDPR , FERPA)

value_map.FR: Freshman: e.g. Less than 1/4th of the total credit hours completed
value_map.SP: Sophomore: e.g. At least (=) 1/4th and less than half of the credits required for graduation
value_map.JR: Junior: e.g. At least 1/2 of total required credits and less than 3/4th of total required
value_map.SR: Senior: e.g. At 3/4th of total required credit hours completed OR student who has completed
value_map.M2: Masters - Year2 ( 50% or more of required credits completed)
value_map.P1: Phase A :Year 1 or 2 or 3 (MBBS), Year 1 (JD or MD), Year 1,2, 3 of DD (Dentistry)
value_map.P2: Phase B: Year 4, 5, 6 (MBBS), Year 2 (JD or MD), Year 4,5 of DD (Dentistry)
value_map.P3: Medical residency and training (above year 5) , Year 3 and above (JD or MD)

fields._note: HEDB 'Student Level' codes -> this form's own (longer, truncated) picklist text. NOTE: different wording from the Enrollments/Attrition forms.

CIP family code -> Area_of_Specialization Name (displayformat [Name]); push sends .Code. 99 -> 'Not listed'. Must equal the first 2 digits of the program's CIP (99 for programs without an official CIP).
displayformat [Code] -> CAA program code imported as-is.

value_map.AE: Academic excellence; Based on the academic performance
value_map.AA: Merit based: Based on academic performance but is automatically renewable for each year
value_map.DS: Discount (when the reduction in tuition is a discount)
value_map.MN: Mixed (Employer AND Sponsor OR/AND institution itself)
value_map.SO: Sponsorship from any other Organization(Other than employer)

fields._note: HEDB 'Scholarship Type' codes. HR (Sponsorship from employer/industrial partner with an intent to hire) is in HEDB 2026 but NOT on the Zoho form -- such rows are flagged.
HEDB 'SC Provider Type' codes. HEDB header has a trailing space.
Free text. HEDB header has a trailing space.
AED per semester (decimal). Link name ends in 1.

value_map.Y: The scholarship/discount/sponsorship is awarded for full academic year
value_map.S: The scholarship/discount/sponsorship is awarded for current semester only
value_map.F: The scholarship/discount/sponsorship is awarded during the entire length of the program of study
